parameters.query:
-- Klaert, welcher Steuersatz der abgerechnete ist.
-- Vergleicht den Satz aus items.contained gegen invoice_data.items
-- und gegen das Verhaeltnis brutto zu netto auf der Buchungsseite.
-- Nur lesend.
WITH paar AS (
    -- Rechnungsposten und gedruckte Zeile ueber die Vorgangsnummer verbunden
    SELECT
        i.invoice_id,
        i.transaction_number,
        i.vat_percent  AS satz_posten,
        l.vat_percent  AS satz_zeile,
        l.vat_type,
        l.price_net,
        l.quantity
    FROM edoobox_raw.invoice_item i
    JOIN edoobox_raw.invoice_line l
      ON l.invoice_id = i.invoice_id
     AND l.transaction_number = i.transaction_number
    WHERE i.transaction_number IS NOT NULL
),
netto_je_buchung AS (
    SELECT booking_id, sum(amount_net * coalesce(quantity, 1)) AS netto
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position
    GROUP BY booking_id
    HAVING sum(amount_net * coalesce(quantity, 1)) > 0
),
faktor AS (
    SELECT
        t.booking_id,
        b.is_b2b,
        i.vat_percent AS satz_posten,
        round(t.amount / n.netto, 3) AS faktor
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking_transaction t
    JOIN netto_je_buchung n ON n.booking_id = t.booking_id
    JOIN edoobox_raw.booking b ON b.booking_id = t.booking_id
    JOIN edoobox_raw.invoice_item i ON i.transaction_id = t.transaction_id
    WHERE t.amount IS NOT NULL AND t.amount > 0
),
ohne_rechnung AS (
    SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, extract(year FROM b.booking_time)::int AS jahr, b.is_b2b
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM edoobox_raw.invoice_item i
        JOIN edoobox_raw.booking_transaction t ON t.transaction_id = i.transaction_id
        WHERE t.booking_id = b.booking_id)
)
SELECT * FROM (
    -- A. Steuerart aus der gedruckten Zeile
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Steuerart aus invoice_line' AS bereich,
           concat(coalesce(vat_type, 'ohne art'), ' bei ',
                  coalesce(vat_percent::text, 'ohne'), ' Prozent') AS kennzahl,
           count(*)::numeric AS wert,
           concat('zeilen in ', count(DISTINCT invoice_id), ' Rechnungen') AS hinweis
    FROM edoobox_raw.invoice_line
    GROUP BY vat_type, vat_percent

    -- B. Posten gegen gedruckte Zeile
    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Posten gegen Zeile',
           concat('posten ', satz_posten::text, ' / zeile ', coalesce(satz_zeile::text, 'ohne')),
           count(*)::numeric,
           CASE WHEN satz_posten = satz_zeile THEN 'gleich' ELSE 'abweichend' END
    FROM paar GROUP BY satz_posten, satz_zeile

    -- C. Postensatz gegen Verhaeltnis brutto zu netto der Buchung
    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Postensatz gegen Faktor',
           concat('satz ', coalesce(satz_posten::text, 'ohne'), ' / faktor ',
                  coalesce(faktor::text, 'ohne')),
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('b2b ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_b2b), ' / nicht b2b ',
                  count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_b2b IS NOT TRUE))
    FROM faktor
    GROUP BY satz_posten, faktor
    HAVING count(*) >= 5

    -- D. Vorzeichen der Postenbetraege
    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'D Vorzeichen',
           concat(item_type, ' ',
                  CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN 'negativ' WHEN amount > 0 THEN 'positiv'
                       WHEN amount = 0 THEN 'null' ELSE 'leer' END),
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('summe ', round(sum(amount), 2), ' / betrag ohne vorzeichen ',
                  round(sum(abs(amount)), 2))
    FROM edoobox_raw.invoice_item
    GROUP BY item_type, 3

    -- E. Buchungen ohne Rechnung
    UNION ALL SELECT 50, 'E Buchung ohne Rechnung', concat(status, ' ', jahr::text),
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('b2b ', count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_b2b))
    FROM ohne_rechnung GROUP BY status, jahr

    -- F. Rechnungen ohne Buchung
    UNION ALL SELECT 60, 'F Rechnung ohne Buchung',
           concat(coalesce(r.invoice_number, 'ohne nummer'), ' status ', coalesce(r.status::text, 'ohne')),
           coalesce(r.amount, 0),
           concat('erstellt ', coalesce(to_char(r.date_create, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'ohne'),
                  ' / posten ', (SELECT count(*) FROM edoobox_raw.invoice_item q WHERE q.invoice_id = r.invoice_id))
    FROM edoobox_raw.invoice r
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM edoobox_raw.invoice_item i
        JOIN edoobox_raw.booking_transaction t ON t.transaction_id = i.transaction_id
        WHERE i.invoice_id = r.invoice_id)

    -- G. Deckung der Nettobetraege
    UNION ALL SELECT 70, 'G Netto', 'summe price_net_summation aus invoice_line',
           (SELECT round(sum(price_net_summation), 2) FROM edoobox_raw.invoice_line)::numeric,
           'nur Rechnungen ab 2023'
    UNION ALL SELECT 71, 'G Netto', 'summe taxBasisTotalAmount',
           (SELECT round(sum(tax_basis_total), 2) FROM edoobox_raw.invoice)::numeric, NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 72, 'G Netto', 'summe rechnungsbetrag ab 2023',
           (SELECT round(sum(amount), 2) FROM edoobox_raw.invoice WHERE tax_total IS NOT NULL)::numeric,
           NULL
) x
ORDER BY ordnung, wert DESC, kennzahl;
